«Nest again» reads the order's file where it was opened from when no ERP folder is chosen [skip ci]

The owner, on his computer (2.0.19): «إعادة التعشيق» stopped with «مجلد process غير محدد أو لا يمكن الوصول إليه» — his
orders are opened by hand, no ERP orders folder is chosen and no copy of the XML is kept (as installed), so an order
could not be made again at all. With no ERP folder chosen the order's file is read again where it was read from: the
file itself, never an old copy. Gone from there, the message says where it was.
(With an ERP folder chosen nothing changes: only from «process», as before.)
tests/test_level7_safeguards.py (+1, fails on 2.0.19). The build is started after the full suite.

Also in this build (2.0.19, in case that one was passed over): the security review's corrections («تذكرني», every user
on approved computers) and what cut an order twice or held the nesting queue.
